name: benops-rpa
description: Claude Code skills for the BenOps RPA team at Gusto

features: Daily briefing, triage, and sync workflows for BenOps RPA engineers
Ticket investigation with Orchestrator log analysis and automatic Sheets tracking update
Status updates via Slack, Notion sync, and test case creation
Reportable Jira fields filled on pickup, prompted automatically when a BT key is mentioned

components.name: analyze
components.description: Review current branch changes for XAML issues, naming conventions, and selector quality

components.name: benops-rpa-setup
components.description: Interactive VDI setup for new BenOps RPA team members

components.name: benops-sync
components.description: Sync BenOps RPA Hub Notion page with current GitHub PR statuses, Jira ticket statuses, and incident records

components.name: benops-ticket-investigation
components.description: Structured investigation for BenOps RPA production failures — marks ticket In Progress in Sheets, then pulls Orchestrator logs

components.name: benops-triage-agent
components.description: First-response triage for a BenOps RPA support ticket

components.name: followup
components.description: Daily status update to Sri/Oscar via Slack

components.name: morning
components.description: Daily briefing — priority contacts, Slack alerts, Jira tickets, open PRs

components.name: ticket-fields
components.description: Fill the eight reportable fields on a BT support ticket in the order the Jira automations need — Process, Complexity, Story Points, Status, Priority, then Sprint, Ticket Type, Workaround Solutions and Category of Break

components.name: uipath-test-cases-from-ticket
components.description: Create UiPath Staging test cases from a Jira ticket

components.name: bt-ticket-fields-gate
components.description: UserPromptSubmit — when a prompt mentions a BT ticket, reminds the agent to set the eight reportable fields first. Non-blocking.
